internal_notes: The CHED memoranda (CMO 87 and 86) could not be read; the semester arrangement is a NoteLib reference arrangement and is not a claim that CHED prescribes it.

No Note generation, Study Pack generation, SQL, metadata change, collection creation or publication is authorized by this workbook. The owner authorizes each separately and runs every production write.

Terms freeze at publication, and publishing cascades PUBLIC to every Subject Plan. Publish only after the per-plan placement check (expected versus actual by id, section and order; Excluded Notes absent; duplicates none) reads clean (BSIS decision D-58).
Authored Depth is one value per canonical Note across every collection that holds it. The calculus and mechanics Notes are held by the public CELE Comprehensive Review: never relabel them.

Emoji are separate metadata for the Study Journey and its Subject Plans. They are never part of a canonical Note title. Where a Subject Plan already exists in another published journey its established emoji is preserved (Understanding the Self, Mathematics in the Modern World, Discrete Mathematics).
Public titles use the pattern '[emoji] BS [Program] — 1st Year'. Already published journeys are not renamed by this workbook; aligning them is a separate consistency decision.
